title: Airfoil Wind Tunnel
what: A custom wind tunnel for measuring lift and drag on our design team’s airfoils under controlled airflow.
why: To research and optimize the aerodynamic performance of our plane by developing the more efficient airfoils for improved liftoff and in-flight control of our aircraft.
how: Modeled the wind tunnel in CAD, fabricated components via CNC and 3D printing, then integrated a stepper-motor drive, load cells, and wiring to a Raspberry Pi for data capture and analysis.
